role: Route one multi-session uncertainty-map operation without performing it.
notes: Chart owns one new map set; Advance owns one existing decision-ticket cycle; a settled map may separately enter To Spec. No direct implementation route.

children.note: One new draft, local, or tracker map-set artifact
One existing map and exactly one frontier decision-ticket cycle
Settled-map specification only on a separate request

pipeline: pin actual caller, immutable map/source candidate, evidence, authority, and optional worktree identity
1-wayfinder-chart for one new map set or 1-wayfinder-advance for one existing ticket cycle
return exact artifacts, effects, frontier/fog, and settlement status to actual caller
materially ambiguous settlement only → F8; separately requested settled-map output → 1-to-spec

forks.question: Which one uncertainty-map operation is needed?
forks.recommended: Infer chart, advance, or settled-spec output from the named candidate

forks.question: Which frontier decision ticket should advance?
forks.recommended: Use the user-named ticket or the unique/declared-first eligible frontier ticket

forks.question: Is the map settled enough for specification?
forks.recommended: Stay in Wayfinder whenever material fog remains
